## Change and mathematical scope

This composes PR #59's split-pair group choices with PR #55's dual-suffix layout and the unchanged ranked joint compiler from PR #60. It improves PR #60's conditional exponent saving by **1.3974275711%**:

$$
T(n)=O\left(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}\right),\qquad
\kappa=\frac{120777349}{2500000000000}=4.83109396\times10^{-5}.
$$

The result remains conditional on the inherited base theorem and all-size analytic, residual-compiler, routing, recovery and fixed finite-alphabet multitape interfaces. This comparison is to #60. Main now records the stronger reviewed saving 5.1016920170078e-5; this contribution preserves a separate, weaker conditional construction and does not claim to improve that current frontier. No global optimization or practical runtime claim is made.

### Construction

Use split-group vectors `[1,3,2]` at h=23 and `[1,2,2]` at h=25. Both axes use PR #55's native suffix layout: input order at the top, the inherited deeper support orders, and the original total fold orders. The exact PR #60 ranked reclamation engine is unchanged. No paid clones or recorded PR #59 permutation overrides are used.

| Quantity | PR #60 | This composition |
|---|---:|---:|
| Auxiliary roles, h=23 | 30,688 | 30,118 |
| Auxiliary roles, h=25 | 40,338 | 39,663 |
| Physical width W | 150,167,598 | 147,661,173 |

Every selected frame transition, clearing XOR, output copy and cleanup is included. The exact bit saving is `2415663683/50000000000000`, full rank mass is `84903327575`, and rank deficit is `1846900`. The fixed I+J data geometry and complex branch are inherited unchanged.

The new package is separate in `research/split-dual/`, with dedicated compiler, verifier and certificates. It privately loads the graph sources and restores temporary provider/module substitutions, including exceptional exits. Original PR #59 files and a complete immutable PR #60 comparison certificate remain pinned. Adding the target and notices refreshes only the old package's root-file source bindings and derived metadata; its code, words, profiles, numerical result and existing verifier remain intact.

### Attribution

- **Rohan Garg (@rohangar1), [PR #59](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/59):** split-pair recursion and group choices, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
- **Rohan Gupta (@gupt1156), [PR #55](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/55):** dual-suffix layout, with Anthropic Claude assistance.

- **Chafik Boukhalfa (@chafreaky), [PR #60](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/60) and this PR:** ranked reclamation, explicit graph composition, isolation, comparison and integration, with OpenAI Codex assistance.

The inherited construction retains **Avi Eisenberg (@ikeboy)** ([#53](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/53)), **Rohan Arun (@rohanarun)** ([#44](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/44), [#49](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/49)), **RaD (@hipotures)** ([#41](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/41), [#51](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/51)), **@icekylinx** ([#36](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/36)), **Dominik Scholz (@DominikScholz)** ([#35](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/35)), **James Chang (@jamesyc)** ([#34](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/34)), **Zhihao Chen (@jacklightChen)** ([#7](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7)), and **Aurel Prosz (@Paureel)** ([#1](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1)).

Earlier contributions and retained checks also credit **@Bortlesboat** ([#2](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2)), **@dleen** ([#4](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4)), **Ryan S (@princezuda)** ([#26](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/26)), **Alejandro Zarzuelo Urdiales (@alejandrozu)** ([#45](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/45)), and **Douglas Colkitt (@Mister-Meeseeks)** ([maintainer integration](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/fc74109a6978cb1849547e0dcb9d9df995ddaac5)). **Swapnil Jain (@Swapnil-jain)** retains the linked two-stage credit recorded in [#29](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/29). OpenAI, David Harvey, Joris van der Hoeven and every earlier contributor retain their manuscript/source attribution. All original notices, licenses and contributor-specific AI-assistance disclosures remain attached to their sources.

## Validation

The receipt-only head `701b124` starts a fresh complete CI run after the preceding receipt head encountered an external Lean 4.31.0 download HTTP 500 in `formal (matrix)`. That failure occurred before the proof ran; all other jobs passed. The upstream rerun API requires maintainer rights, so an accurate metadata-only receipt records the failure and triggers this retry. Final-head success remains pending until observed.

The verified construction is `b07443b7fb73200eeca4e681a2bccc226ef938b1`, with source freeze `43368c897bf61e6cab9d7275451241d57083f8381af9871cf4bb8cc1d67e129f`. The final repository receipt is a metadata-only follow-up; it does not change any source pin, word, profile or numerical certificate.

- Fresh word regeneration matches both selected words byte-for-byte. Independent complete source/target/dirty-basis replay in both orientations and actual CRT profile regeneration pass.
- Exact rational moments exclude the complete PR #60 child list at the new bit saving. All 47 strict assembly inequalities, seven margins, eventual cutoffs and next-grid rejections pass.
- **14 focused split-dual controls** pass, including physical mutations, omitted charges, provider restoration on failure and assertion-disabled Python rejection. Independent review additionally rejects seven source/manifest/artifact mutations.
- Fresh `make -j1 verify-joint` passes at the verified construction in **309.334 seconds**, with a byte-clean checkout. This includes the predecessor witnesses and independent PR60/61 arithmetic/source binding.
- All **eleven verification groups** complete locally on the merged source tree, including **530 isolated tests across 79 modules** and **20 patch checks**. The initial run on `29a504f` completed five groups before Apple clang rejected an inherited OpenMP flag; the remaining six completed with a task-local adapter to installed libomp and existing hash-verified Boost. Exact attempt and continuation records are retained. Canonical ordering of two derived receipts was restored without changing their parsed JSON values, then rechecked clean at `b07443b`.
- All **36 unique CI checks** pass at `b07443b`: eleven groups on Python 3.11, 3.13 and 3.14 plus all three inherited Lean packages. Both workflow invocations are green, **72 successful check runs** total.
- The original `ac0bc93` full run also passed: 443 integrated tests, all focused checks and 20 patches in 1096.909 seconds. That historical record retains its own tested source freeze.

Main `fc74109` is integrated additively: all upstream additions and the complete current CI architecture remain. Independent reconciliation review confirms unchanged physical/numerical witnesses and only three root-file pin updates. The maintainer-reviewed headline remains 5.1016920170078e-5; this PR's separate conditional construction is weaker than that current frontier.

Reproduce with:

```sh
make split-dual-verify
make verify
```

`certificates/split-dual-repository-validation.json` records exact commits, source hashes, checks and log digests. See `research/split-dual/PROOF.md` for the local algebra and inherited all-size residual-compiler, routing, recovery and fixed-tape obligations. The inherited Lean checks do not constitute a formal proof of this complete multiplication theorem.

|---|---:|---:|

title: Zero-circuit live clearing: conditional kappa = 5.14154245470094e-5 above #71

body:
This draft composes envelope-node ordering with profile-cost carried-signal exchanges on anchored split frames. Its conditional bound is

$$
T(n)=O\left(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}\right),\qquad
\kappa=\frac{51738676045141}{10^{18}}=5.1738676045141\times10^{-5}.
$$

This is **0.6287052980% above PR #75**, whose reported conditional exponent is `257077122735047/(5*10^18)` at `da9b6cbebb33e8b8293a604dde0eace9de53406b`. The exact comparison is `κ − (201/200)κ₇₅ = 66174375396553/10^21 > 0`. Bit saving is **25870676537201/(5*10^17)**. Complete finite compiler/profile/arithmetic checks and independent serialized replay pass; deterministic regeneration and broad repository CI remain pending. All inherited all-size and transfer hypotheses remain conditional.

## Change

Compose Thomas DiFiore's PR #74 scalar-node envelope ordering with Chafik Boukhalfa's frozen PR #71 anchored split construction and three passes of PR #70-style carried-signal exchanges. Each exchange preserves matching cardinality, unique uses, eligible dependencies and independence of output rows plus retained input rows. Integer profile-entropy scores guide discovery; acceptance uses the complete physical word and paid recursive profile.

Both axes use the same envelope ordering, preserving scalar forms and remapping all argument/output identifiers. The compiler checks every dependency, containment and dirty basis; reclamation pays literal XOR operations and frame raises for both targets and controls. PR #75's distinct nonlinear provider-circuit method is not incorporated.

| Quantity | Frozen PR #71 | This draft |
|---|---:|---:|
| h=23 auxiliary roles | 27,455 | 27,256 |
| h=25 auxiliary roles | 36,015 | 35,720 |
| Physical wires W | 135,075,665 | **134,095,520** |
| Conditional κ | 51414646104039/10^18 | **51738676045141/10^18** |
| Assembly backoff | 10^-12 | unchanged |

The complete recursive rank is **77,103,077,100**, with deficit **1,846,900**. Copied centers, endpoints, data geometry and the complex layer remain charged. Because W crossed below `2^27`, the bridge derives wire-bit width **27**, row coefficient **843**, and degree gap **7007/25**; degree **2000** and suffix slope **8000** remain unchanged. Stale width fields are rejected rather than bypassed.

## Verification

Passed: both complete compiler input/dirty-basis checks in both orientations; actual literal transition reconstruction; complete fixed-basis profiles with zero CRT disagreements; source/word bindings; independent serialized dirty-word replay and profile regeneration; complete paid child/rank identity; independent rational moment enclosures and adjacent bit-grid rejection; all **47 strict assembly inequalities and seven margins**; and next-κ-grid rejection. The separate independent validation receipt will be added as a follow-up artifact; the frozen manifest correctly retains its initial pending status.

**Pending:** portable deterministic compiler regeneration, dedicated CI integration for this package, broad repository checks and CI review. Existing inherited CI checks remain enabled. This draft is published before those follow-up checks. Finite evidence does not establish the inherited all-size compiler, analytic, routing, prime-selection, recovery, fixed-tape or transfer theorem, global optimality or practical runtime gain.

git archive 1bef94fd40a746452548c84a4a8f8834670a3113 | tar -x -C research/round6-pr71/baseline
